crossRefs.note: Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse.
Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.
For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”
Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold…
“He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man…
“Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,
For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right:
“Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’
that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’
Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand…

translations.web: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.
translations.bsb: Your own mouth, not mine, condemns you; your own lips testify against you.
translations.kjv: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify
translations.asv: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I; Yea, thine own lips testify against thee.
